lines.1: And just like that, another cool, outrageously strong-willed girl appeared.
lines.2: But her unexpectedly expressive, cute side may still be a charm only I know about.
lines.3: The sky shifts from the blazing heat of summer toward the calm of autumn.
lines.4: But there's no guarantee my own life will grow any calmer.
lines.5: My hectic days will continue for some time yet.
